text:
Maria (CS): Heads up — LarkNet asked for a temporary EU peering/provision change for a customer-facing demo next Tuesday. They want a short QPS bump + IP allowlist so their demo traffic doesn't hit blocks. Renewal flagged (high visibility).
Ajay (Platform): OK — what's the requested QPS and exact window? which region? any model/seq details?
Maria (CS): EU region (eu-west-1). Requested steady 1200 qps for 2 hours (2026-06-01 10:00-12:00 UTC). Model is an open-small (median seq ~64). CIDRs to add: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.128/25. They
re still onboarding — demo is part of renewal conversation on 2026-06-08.
Praveen (SE): For hosted mode we can add those CIDRs to the proxy allowlist and apply a temporary rate override on their account. Recommend auto-revoke after 3 hours in case of drift. Also propose a 10% canary for the first 5 minutes.
Maria (CS): Account: acct-larknet-77. Ticket created: CS-4129. Auto-revoke + canary works. Also requested a 09:30 UTC enablement walkthrough prior to the demo.
Ajay (Platform): I'll prepare the infra change and mark maintenance. Example config I'll push to the ops queue:
```json
{"account_id":"acct-larknet-77","region":"eu-west-1","temp_qps":1200,"start":"2026-06-01T10:00:00Z","end":"2026-06-01T12:00:00Z","allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.128/25"],"revoke_after_seconds":10800,"canary_pct":10}
```
Praveen (SE): LGTM. Will watch tail-latency (p95/p99), 5xx rate, and token cost. If we see CPU/GPU contention in the Dedicated pool, fallback policy should route to compatible smaller model and rate-limit per-token. I'll prepare a quick rollback playbook.
Rebecca (Enablement): I can run the 09:30 walkthrough and record it. Please add me to the invite and include expected sample prompts and traffic patterns.
ops-bot: Created OPS-2248: temporary-rate-change for acct-larknet-77 (assignee: Ajay (Platform)). ETA: prep today EOD, change window scheduled per request.
Maria (CS): Great — I'll confirm with the customer that the CIDRs are correct and share the walkthrough invite. Also flagging renewal: this demo is a key proof point; capture feedback and performance notes so RM can reference.
Ajay (Platform): After the window I'll upload perf snapshots, canary metrics, and the post-change diff to the thread. :thumbsup:
Praveen (SE): Also adding a short note for billing team: estimated incremental cost for 2-hour 1200 qps window ~ +$X00 (will calculate exact). Recommend Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching + prefix cache) in renewal doc.
Maria (CS): Perfect — I'll send the follow-up email with a post-demo feedback survey (link: https://redwood.internal/forms/larknet-demo-feedback) and tag RM. Thanks everyone.
